name: 陶艺工坊

parameters.prompt: An asymmetric Japanese artists and pottery atelier with twin offset gables, north-light glass strips, generous studio windows and peach plaster details. Japanese small-town miniature, readable front entrance facing +Z. Warm timber frames, cream plaster, blue-grey kawara tiles, shoji lattice windows, subtle red or sage noren. Rich handmade details, softly faceted low-poly forms, light matte materials. One complete exterior, flat grounded base, no interior, landscape, people, text, floating parts or baked shadows. Follow the two reference views for proportions, enrich the architecture. Footprint about 4 by 3.5 units, height under 4.2.

adoption: accepted after front, rear and side visual review; scene integration remains separate

inspection.notes: Complete miniature exterior, no visible major holes or detached parts.
